parts.title: Glass Moon
parts.note: Suddenly, I wake up.^Lured by the distant clamor, I^head into the dark, dark forest.

parts.title: Prologue
parts.note: When I come to, I find myself in^a hospital bed. The world around^me is scrawled with lines.

parts.title: Early morning; The city awakens
parts.note: The end of a familiar routine. I^leave the Arima house, where I^spent the last seven years. This^is the last time I will see this^scenery.

parts.title: I have nothing to talk about
parts.note: I run into Ciel-senpai, a school^celebrity. Sadly, I have nothing^to talk to her about.

parts.title: A question crosses my mind
parts.note: I actually do have a question for^her. This is as good an^opportunity as any, so I may as^well ask it.

parts.title: I must admire these works of art
parts.note: I'm distracted by her legs, which^are as toned as those of an^athlete. I wonder if she trains^every day?

parts.title: I head to my classroom
parts.note: Ciel-senpai's in a rush, so I see^her off at the station. After^that, I head to school at my own^pace.

parts.title: I'll meet up with Arihiko
parts.note: I'll have lunch with Arihiko in^the cafeteria today. Apparently^he's invited a special guest.

parts.title: I'll stay and see what happens
parts.note: My mind's still a mess. As I'm^sitting around trying to pull^myself together, Yumizuka Satsuki^calls out to me.

parts.title: I'll figure it out in the hall
parts.note: Should I eat in the cafeteria, or^pick something up at the store?^As I'm trying to make up my mind,^I see a familiar face...

parts.title: I'll figure it out in the hall
parts.note: I'd hoped for a serendipitous^encounter, but no such luck. I^guess I'll go to the cafeteria^after all.

parts.title: 1st day ― After School
parts.note: My thoughts remain clouded, but I^can't stay in this classroom^forever. I wonder what I should^do now.

parts.title: I wander around the school
parts.note: I remember the promise from this^morning. I'll stop by the tea^ceremony clubroom. I'm sure^Ciel-senpai will be there.

parts.title: I wander around the school
parts.note: I'll kill some more time. As I^stroll around the school grounds,^I remember an incident from my^middle school days.

parts.title: Picking up from this morning
parts.note: Apparently Senpai wants to get to^know me better. I don't know if I^can live up to her expectations,^but I'll try talking about recent^events.

parts.title: Picking up from this afternoon
parts.note: Apparently Senpai wants to get to^know me better. I feel like it's^a boring subject, but I'll talk a^bit about myself.

parts.title: I return to the mansion
parts.note: I work up my courage and leave^the school. It's been a long^time, but the route still feels^familiar. As I walk, I think back^on my memories of the Tohno^mansion.

parts.title: Reminiscence
parts.note: It's been seven years... I wonder^how the Tohno mansion has^changed. If there's one thing in^particular I remember, it's――

parts.title: My father, Tohno Makihisa
parts.note: I remember my father, Tohno^Makihisa. He was a strict man,^and disapproved of his son. And^now, he is no longer with us.

parts.title: My sister Akiha, of course
parts.note: I remember my sister, Akiha. I^haven't talked to her at all^since I left... I wonder what's^been going through her head these^past seven years.

parts.title: The other kid who played with us
parts.note: I definitely remember Akiha and I^playing with another child back^then... I wonder who they were.

parts.title: Shiki's Homecoming
parts.note: I return to the Tohno mansion for^the first time in seven years.^Its grandeur is honestly^overwhelming. I'm greeted by――

parts.title: I obediently follow her
parts.note: My memories are still hazy, and I^don't want to accidentally put a^foot wrong. I'll just keep my^mouth shut and let her show me^around.

parts.title: I stop the girl
parts.note: It would be rude to just refer to^her as 'you there'. I stop the^girl in front of me and ask for^her name.

parts.title: I'll explore the mansion
parts.note: The beauty of this almost^palatial mansion has stirred my^curiosity. I want to take a look^around, so I ask the girl in^front of me to stop.

parts.title: Breather in the living room
parts.note: The girl, Kohaku-san, leads me to^the luxurious living room.

parts.title: I'll wait here quietly
parts.note: Even if I want to look around the^mansion, I should greet Akiha^first. I'll just wait here until^she's ready.

parts.title: I'll go for a little walk
parts.note: Ten minutes is plenty for a quick^snoop around the mansion. As soon^as I step out into the lobby, I'm^greeted by――

parts.title: Reunion
parts.note: The office of the Tohno family^head is private. As a child, I^wasn't even allowed to look^inside. Now, my younger sister^Akiha awaits me there.

parts.title: Eldest Son's Room
parts.note: My personal servant, Hisui,^guides me to my room. There is^nothing to do to pass the time^until dinner.

parts.title: Dinner
parts.note: Dinner with the family head has^begun! The air is electric. I^need to learn table manners fast,^or else!

parts.title: Returning to my room
parts.note: I survive my ordeal and make it^back to my room. Something's been^bothering me, so I ask Hisui^about it once she finishes making^the bed.

parts.title: Confirmation
parts.note: Maybe there was a time, back^then...

parts.title: 2nd day ― Morning
parts.note: I wake up from my slumber. This^marks the beginning of a new day^at the Tohno mansion.

parts.title: Prof. Arach's Debut
parts.note: Akiha and I don't have much to^talk about, so we pass the time^in comfortable silence. Until――

parts.title: Going to school from the mansion
parts.note: It's my first day commuting to^school from the Tohno mansion. I^almost feel like a transfer^student as I walk down the^street. The city looks the same^as always, but...

parts.title: The State of the City
parts.note: Arihiko hasn't shown up to class^today. As I scroll through my^phone, I let my mind wander.

parts.title: A New Kind of Homeroom
parts.note: Homeroom is a lot more hectic^than usual this morning. The new^teacher, Noel-sensei, seems like^quite the character.

parts.title: Lunch Break
parts.note: It's time for lunch. Noel-sensei^may have caused a stir, but some^things never change.

parts.title: I'll just eat in the cafeteria
parts.note: I feel like I'm in good shape^today. I'll treat myself to a^lavish 'Meal Set A' at the^cafeteria. I've got money to^burn.

parts.title: I'll just eat in the classroom
parts.note: I'd better keep an eye on my^expenses... When I come back from^buying bread at the school store,^I'm approached by Yumizuka.

parts.title: I'll figure it out in the hall
parts.note: I run into Ciel-senpai in the^hallway. Apparently she's bought^too much food for lunch. I take^her up on her kind offer.

parts.title: I'll figure it out in the hall
parts.note: I run into someone unexpected by^the stairs. The new teacher,^Noel-sensei, is standing by the^wall, looking like she might be^lost.

parts.title: After School
parts.note: School is over for the day. As I^leave the classroom, I bump into^the woman everyone's talking^about: Noel-sensei.

parts.title: I ask about Toyama-sensei
parts.note: I wonder what she means by 'end^up like Toyama-sensei'... I^decide to stop her and ask.

parts.title: I decide to drop the subject
parts.note: I wonder what she means by 'end^up like Toyama-sensei'... but I^decide not to ask.

parts.title: I leave the school
parts.note: I say goodbye to Noel-sensei and^head out of the school gates. I^could just go straight back to^the mansion, but maybe I should^stop somewhere else along the^way?

parts.title: I'll go straight home
parts.note: The head of the family told me I^had to be back before sunset. I^should probably just do as she^says.

parts.title: I'll swing by the restaurant
parts.note: I just remembered that^Yumizuka-san gave me a point^card. It would be a shame for it^to go to waste, maybe I'll go pay^her a visit.

parts.title: I'll take a detour first
parts.note: I'll kill some time before I head^back. I wonder if I should hit up^the shops around the station, or^go to Arihiko's house...

parts.title: For whatever reason...
parts.note: When I come to my senses, I'm in^a back alley downtown. Curfew has^long since passed. I need to get^back to the mansion as soon as^possible.

parts.title: Selinuntius is dead
parts.note: I failed to make it home before^sunset. The tyrant summons me to^her office, and Melos is furious.

parts.title: I'll go talk to Akiha
parts.note: I've already messed up and^angered Akiha. I go to the living^room in hope of talking to her,^but the person who greets me^there is――

parts.title: I'll pay Kohaku-san a visit
parts.note: It's still too early to go to^bed. I wonder if Kohaku-san would^let me watch TV in her room...?

parts.title: I'll stay in my room and relax
parts.note: I pass the time in my room. While^I'm relaxing, someone knocks on^my door.

parts.title: Lights-out
parts.note: At ten o'clock, the mansion's^lights turn off. I don't really^have anything else to do, so I^guess I'll go to sleep.

parts.title: Death Throes
parts.note: I hear the sound of howling^coming from somewhere. It worms^its way into my ears, disturbing^my sleep.

parts.title: 3rd day ― Morning
parts.note: I wake up to an ordinary morning.^I guess what I saw last night was^just a dream. Once I'm done^changing, I head to the dining^room.

parts.title: I greet Akiha
parts.note: I'll say good morning to Akiha^first. It probably doesn't hurt^to be friendly. After all, every^little helps.

parts.title: I greet Kohaku-san
parts.note: I'll say good morning to^Kohaku-san. Her brilliant smile^warms my heart, but I feel like^I'm forgetting someone...

parts.title: I greet both of them
parts.note: Akiha and Kohaku-san are in the^living room. I'd feel awkward^only greeting one of them, so I^wish both of them a good morning.

parts.title: Morning Conversation
parts.note: I wonder if the howling I heard^last night is a regular^occurrence around here. I'll try^asking Akiha and Kohaku-san about^it.

parts.title: Stopped in the Mansion Lobby
parts.note: After finishing breakfast, I get^ready to leave for school. Just^as I'm about to step out of the^door, Kohaku-san stops me.

parts.title: Homeroom with Senpai
parts.note: I'm curious what the deal is with^the bloodstains, but just head^straight to school. When I get to^my classroom, I find Arihiko and^Ciel-senpai waiting for me.

parts.title: Ordinary Homeroom
parts.note: It's not often you see Arihiko at^school this early in the morning.^When I ask him what's up, he^tells me Ciel-senpai had stopped^by earlier.

parts.title: Lunch Break
parts.note: Nothing of interest happened^during classes this morning, and^now it's time for lunch. I wonder^where I should eat today?

parts.title: I eat in the classroom
parts.note: I don't have an appetite today.^When I tell Ciel-senpai I'm^skipping lunch, she looks like^she's just been struck by^lightning.

parts.title: I eat at the cafeteria
parts.note: I decide to have lunch at the^cafeteria. When I get back to the^classroom, I suddenly realize^something...

parts.title: I could go to the tea room...?
parts.note: I'll go pay Ciel-senpai a visit.^After preparing the necessary^tribute, I strike out for the^mysterious tea ceremony room.

parts.title: Dizziness
parts.note: My anemia hits me all of a^sudden, and I almost pass out. I^take Arihiko's suggestion and^leave school early, but I don't^really feel like going straight^back to the mansion...

parts.title: The Fateful Encounter
parts.note: I'll go back to the mansion.^I'll head to my room and sleep.^I wasn't thinking of doing^anything else...^^Until I crossed paths with her.

parts.title: This has to be a bad dream
parts.note: This isn't real.^How could the bright red floor^and dismembered ■■ be anything^but a bad dream?

parts.title: This is the reality I've wrought
parts.note: This is real.^I turn my back on the woman I^killed with my own hands, and^flee the apartment.

parts.title: Slumber
parts.note: I wake up in my own bed. It's^like none of it ever happened. I^knew it was just a bad dream.

parts.title: Unrelenting Rain
parts.note: The falling rain mercilessly saps^the warmth from my body. I have^no home to return to.

parts.title: Guidance
parts.note: Ciel's apartment.^Flowers for the heart.^Water for the flowers.

parts.title: Penitence
parts.note: My sin will never go away. But^even so, I feel like Senpai's^words serve as some measure of^salvation.

parts.title: Whilst the rain softly falls
parts.note: I feel lost, unable to sleep.^What should I do now? How can I^atone for my sins?

parts.title: 4th day ― Morning
parts.note: I'm haunted by that nightmare I^had. I can't even get a good^night's sleep. I have to take my^mind off it somehow...

parts.title: 4th day ― Morning
parts.note: I ring in the morning in Ciel's^room. Accepting yesterday's^events, I head out to bid^farewell.

parts.title: Morning Meal
parts.note: Kohaku-san wants me to eat^breakfast, but I don't have an^appetite. I'll head to school^as-is.

parts.title: I ask about Akiha
parts.note: This is a good opportunity to get^to know Akiha better. I'll ask^her about the things we haven't^talked about yet, like her^school.

parts.title: I have a word about Kohaku-san
parts.note: We've got some time before^breakfast is ready. Struggling to^come up with something to talk^about with Akiha, I turn the^topic to Kohaku-san.

parts.title: I ask about the mansion
parts.note: We've got some time before^breakfast is ready. I've been^wondering what's going on with^the mansion, so I ask Akiha about^it.

parts.title: The Last Morning Trip Home
parts.note: I make up my mind and return to^the mansion. There, everyday life^continues as usual. I reflect on^that life, reluctant to part with^it.

parts.title: Kohaku-san arrives with breakfast
parts.note: Kohaku-san made a special^breakfast for me because I'm not^feeling well. I accept it^graciously.

parts.title: Reunion
parts.note: Hisui sees me off as I leave the^main gate. The route I take to^school looks the same as it^always does. But the person^waiting for me is――

parts.title: Reunion
parts.note: Hisui sees me off as I leave the^main gate. The route I take to^school looks the same as it^always does. But the person^waiting for me is――

parts.title: Back Alley Rendezvous
parts.note: The vampire talks to me. Except,^what she says doesn't make any^sense at all!

parts.title: Black Beast
parts.note: I see eyes glinting in the^darkness behind the woman in^white. I'm being watched by a^black panther――an animal that^doesn't belong in a city.

parts.title: How should I reply?
parts.note: The monster in the guise of a^woman gently urges me to make a^choice. My answer is――

parts.title: I... will help her
parts.note: I know it isn't something I'm^equipped to handle, but I just^couldn't say no.

parts.title: No, I will never cooperate
parts.note: I won't cooperate with her.^Absolutely not. I can't do what^cannot be done.

parts.title: Alice in the River of Flame
parts.note: ――Location unknown.

parts.title: We arrive at the luxury hotel
parts.note: Arcueid has rented the top floor^of a hotel in anticipation of an^enemy attack. For now, I should^listen to what she has to say.

parts.title: Enough with all this... I'll run
parts.note: If there's ever a time to return^to my normal life, it's now. I^slip out of the hotel and make my^final decision at the park.

parts.title: I won't lose my way... I'll stay
parts.note: I can't break my promise to her.^If I'm the one who weakened^Arcueid, then I have to stay and^help her.

parts.title: I'll go back to the mansion
parts.note: I never want to go through^something like that again.^Telling myself that, I start to^head back to the mansion when――

parts.title: I'll go back to the hotel
parts.note: I can't betray her trust. I'll^head back to the hotel, and stand^guard until morning comes.

parts.title: Once Upon a Summer Day
parts.note: Something reminds me of days gone^by. Was what I saw on that^summer's day actually real?

parts.title: The Vampire's Long Lecture
parts.note: What I need right now is answers.^When I ask her a question, it^kicks off a strange lecture about^vampires.

parts.title: The Vampire's Longer Lecture
parts.note: My conversation with Arcueid^continues. Vampires are divided^into True Ancestors and Dead^Apostles, but what's the^difference between the two?

parts.title: The Murderer and His Glasses
parts.note: Now it's my turn to answer her^questions. How did a mere human^manage to kill a vampire?

parts.title: I give up and hand them over
parts.note: Arcueid strong-arms me into^handing over my glasses. She^examines them intently, and^then――

parts.title: I'm not handing them over
parts.note: I don't trust that look in her^eyes one bit. I can't risk her^breaking them. There's no way in^hell I'm handing them over.

parts.title: Night Talk
parts.note: There's only an hour left until^dawn. Nothing unusual has^happened, so we pass the time^with idle conversation.

parts.title: If she's a vampire, then...
parts.note: Has Arcueid also killed humans,^and sucked their blood? If she^has, then how many...?

parts.title: Blue Flame
parts.note: Another vampire arrives.^The hotel becomes hell on earth.

parts.title: I'll see what's going on outside
parts.note: I can't just stand around any^longer. I leave Arcueid in the^room and go see what's happening.

parts.title: I'll stay and see what happens
parts.note: It would be dangerous to rush out^unprepared. I decide to stay in^the room and see how things^develop. But was that the right^call...?

parts.title: Patchwork World
parts.note: The inflamed dog has breathed its^last. My headache is only getting^worse. Is any of this even real?

parts.title: Sudden Tragedy
parts.note: The Dead Apostle arrives together^with the flames.^The hallway burns.^My memories are hazy.^The phantom pain incinerates none^but the living.

parts.title: 5th day ― Morning
parts.note: We arrive at Arcueid's apartment^after finally leaving the hotel^behind us. I'll let her rest for^the time being.

parts.title: The Bizarre Duct Tape Woman
parts.note: I've checked to make sure Arcueid^is alright. Even though I know^she isn't human, her smile still^fills me with relief.

parts.title: Please Rest
parts.note: I somehow manage to administer^some first aid. My patient really^ought to get some rest, too, but^she really doesn't want to sleep.

parts.title: Teach me, Arcueid-sensei
parts.note: The Twenty-Seven Ancestors:^Ancient vampires who stand at the^top of the Dead Apostle world.

parts.title: Am I To Blame?
parts.note: Confession and forgiveness.^The decision to atone.^The decision to commit.

parts.title: Determined to Fight
parts.note: I'm done running away. Arcueid is^gearing up for a protracted^battle――do I follow along with^her plan?

parts.title: I'll stay here until nightfall...
parts.note: We can't let that guy go^unchecked for three whole days.^We'll wait for Arcueid to recover^a little, then engage him^tonight!

parts.title: I should look for Vlov right away
parts.note: We can't wait until nightfall. We^have to find and defeat Vlov^before he kills again.

parts.title: Strategy Meeting
parts.note: We've decided what we need to do.^Arcueid and I work to come up^with a plan to defeat Vlov.

parts.title: To Vlov's Stronghold
parts.note: I sneak out of the apartment,^leaving the still-sleeping^Arcueid behind, and head for the^department store in front of the^station.

parts.title: Deciding on a plan of action
parts.note: After night falls, we wait around^in the park trying to lure Vlov^out. But instead, an unforeseen^disaster strikes!

parts.title: Consequences
parts.note: You're first in line. The^restaurant has plenty of empty^seats, so we'll be with you right^away.

parts.title: Subterranean Descent
parts.note: The elevator is going down,^deeper and deeper, as if carrying^me into the depths of hell.

parts.title: From Hell
parts.note: The disease spreads above ground.^The river of flame breaks its^banks and gushes forth. The air^is filled with the squeals of^pigs being boiled alive.

parts.title: In the Depths of Hell
parts.note: I wander through the darkness.^Hordes of the living dead.^Corpses piled upon corpses. This^place is hell itself.

parts.title: Into the Night
parts.note: Arcueid and I leap to the roof of^a building to get a bird's-eye^view of the city. Avatar in^white, disperse these flames!

parts.title: Reason
parts.note: I grab Noel-sensei and run. These^freakish catacombs have driven^her half-mad.

parts.title: The Tempest Descends
parts.note: The humanoid missile makes^contact. The earth splits open,^and the downtown area caves in. I^need to get down there too!

parts.title: The Ladder to Paradise
parts.note: There's a man-made chamber^underground. A horde of cadavers^surrounds the sacrifice. How am I^going to save her?

parts.title: Vlov Arkhangel (I)
parts.note: I leave the roof, run down the^stairs, and make it outside. Down^in the pit of the cave-in,^Arcueid's battle has already^begun.

parts.title: Hands of Flame
parts.note: Fire floods the hallway. Not^content to simply burn Noel, he^pulls her to him.

parts.title: I should descend
parts.note: The enemy's location is clear. I^need to do my part――there's no^getting cold feet now!

parts.title: I should observe the situation
parts.note: The ground down there is^blanketed with those blue flames.^I've got to just stay here and^observe for now...

parts.title: I'll save Noel
parts.note: I hear a voice I'll never forget.^I can't let this happen. My body^starts moving before my mind can^catch up.

parts.title: I'll abandon Noel
parts.note: I hear a voice I'll never forget.^But, he's too far away for me to^do anything.

parts.title: I should just watch what happens
parts.note: I won't make it in time at this^point. All I can do now is watch^the battle from a distance.

parts.title: I should tell Arcueid to stop
parts.note: There's no way in hell I'm^getting involved in that. Even^though I know I don't have to do^anything, my sense of reason is^screaming at me.

parts.title: Inconceivable Amputation
parts.note: Vlov doesn't register me as a^threat. I can probably take him^by surprise. Just like this――

parts.title: Infernal Delusion
parts.note: We've made a fatal mistake――^The second Arcueid's arm pierces^his chest, our enemy reveals his^true nature.

parts.title: I continue to press on!
parts.note: I can end this once and for all^if I keep going. I just need to^take one more step. Alas, the^price of overconfidence is steep.

parts.title: I can't, I need to breathe!
parts.note: I got a glimpse of his abilities^back at the hotel. I've got to^keep my distance. Alas, the price^for my recklessness is...

parts.title: Vlov Arkhangel (II)
parts.note: Arcueid's probably done for.^Running away while I still can^would be the right decision. But,^could I really do that...?

parts.title: The Twenty-Seven Ancestors
parts.note: Ciel-senpai messed up.^A billowing white curse.^The underground chamber is frozen^solid.

parts.title: Trump Card
parts.note: The ice bullets are bearing down^on me. Will I continue to hide my^secret weapon, or will I show my^hand?

parts.title: I rush over to Senpai
parts.note: I'm going to save Senpai,^obviously! I frantically sprint^toward her back. But I can't^escape from this!

parts.title: I rush over to Sensei
parts.note: I look back at Noel-sensei.^I've already made my decision.^I have to do what I can!

parts.title: If there's a way, it's throwing
parts.note: I am the instrument of his^demise. If I can't get close,^I'll just have to try something^else!

parts.title: If there's a way, it's sliding
parts.note: If there's a way to get close,^it's by gliding. I can't afford^to hesitate!

parts.title: If there's a way, it's towing
parts.note: If I can't get close to him, then^I'll force him to come to us.^Arcueid's strong enough to make^it work!

parts.title: One-on-One Lesson with Noel
parts.note: The chamber dome collapses around^me. When I wake up, the world^around me is cramped, dark, and^soft... soft?!

parts.title: Percentage Showtime
parts.note: No. 19 of the Twenty-Seven^Ancestors――cut down. Sink into^the northern seas, vampire. Blood^does not warmth make.

parts.title: Escaping the Depths of the Earth
parts.note: We finally make it back to the^surface. Even the faint rays of^the setting sun feel warm.^However, Senpai's gaze is frosty.

parts.title: Sleeping Without Fear
parts.note: It's finally over. After^exhausting everything that I^have, I fall into a deep sleep.

parts.title: An Indignant Arcueid
parts.note: I make my way back to her^apartment again. In order to^quell her anger, I'll tell her^all about what happened.

parts.title: Cleanup Crew
parts.note: A few hours have passed since^Vlov's demise. Atop that^contaminated land――

parts.title: In the Mist
parts.note: We survey the city from atop a^building. A massive barrier has^appeared amid the rubble.^Senpai's down there fighting as^we speak!

parts.title: Irritation
parts.note: I rush down the stairs. I need to^get down to where Senpai is as^fast as possible, and sever^Vlov's 'line'!

parts.title: Cage of Cold
parts.note: I've made it to the threshold of^the barrier, but I'm not able to^get inside. How am I supposed to^help Senpai?

parts.title: I look at Ciel-senpai
parts.note: I hunt around trying to spot^Ciel-senpai. There she^is――buried in a pile of rubble.^I need to go help her right away!

parts.title: I look at Vlov
parts.note: It doesn't look like Vlov's able^to move... That attack must have^taken a lot out of him. I need to^seize this chance to help Senpai.

parts.title: Waltz of Frost
parts.note: We begin our assault on Vlov. Our^impromptu coordination is like a^beautiful duet.

parts.title: The Final Rest is my Home
parts.note: To the bosom, flowers. As^atonement, the prayers of the^Holy Maiden!

parts.title: Goodnight
parts.note: My body can't move anymore.^Senpai's voice is the only thing^I hear as I drift off into a deep^sleep.

parts.title: Cleanup Crew
parts.note: Two hours have already passed^since Vlov's demise. A media^blackout has been imposed, and^the area is off-limits. Upon the^scene stands a boy.

parts.title: 6th day ― Morning
parts.note: I wake up in my own bed.^My wounds are deep, and I can^barely walk. But at least I made^it out alive.

parts.title: 6th day ― Morning
